messages.content:
<document id=DOC_posting_ten_five>
Mandatory requirements.
1. Python.
2. SQL.
3. Linux administration.
4. Git.
5. REST API design.
6. Unit testing.
7. CI pipelines.
8. Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm.
9. Kafka.
10. GraphQL.

Nice to have.
11. Grafana.
12. Prometheus.
13. Technical writing.
14. Mentoring.
15. Public speaking.
</document>

<document id=DOC_resume_at_floor>
Languages: Python, SQL.
Platform: Linux administration, Git.
Services: REST API design, unit testing, CI pipelines.
Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible.
Observability: Grafana, Prometheus.
Other: technical writing, mentoring, public speaking.
</document>

Assess the candidate against the posting below. A numbered requirement that
lists several items counts as one requirement, credited in proportion to how
many of those items the candidate shows. Report the mandatory match
percentage. If it lands between 78 and 84 percent, also report the combined
figure over all requirements and proceed only if that reaches 85 percent.

response.text:
**Mandatory match: 78%** (7.8 / 10).

Requirement 8 is only partial: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Ansible are shown; Helm is not (4/5). Kafka and GraphQL are absent. Items 1–7 are fully met.

**Combined match: 85.3%** (12.8 / 15).

All five nice-to-haves are met (Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, public speaking). That combined figure reaches 85%, so the candidate clears the bar.

**Assessment:** Meets the gate. Strong on the core stack (Python, SQL, Linux, Git, REST, testing, CI) and on observability and soft skills. Gaps are Helm, Kafka, and GraphQL—one partial infrastructure line and two missing mandatory services. Hire only if those three can be trained or are not day-one critical.
